notes.title: V2 update
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Tetron's first new update has just released. Here are the full patch notes, but the most notable stuff is that default movement speed has increased, there are 2 new characters, you can loop the game, and some big mana system changes. 

If you are reading this as the patch notes come out, there is going to be a sale going on! 
Also, if you donate the amount of money the game costs to a charity that is working to aid the lives of Black Americans or indigenous people and DM a picture of proof to our [url=https://twitter.com/heurlectic]twitter[/url], then you will get a free copy of the game. 

I hope any new buyers enjoy and any old owners enjoy the new features! Here are the full patch notes:


Bambodi (?) added 
[list]
[*]Projectile shoots a slow but explosive shot
[*]Tactical is shooting a big, high damage bomb
[*]Ultimate is kamikaze, for a short period of time you explode in place dealing massive damage to nearby enemies. 
[/list]
	   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38196885/41c3d80a92617faf12f26b7e109e29b9dcc0ca29.png[/img]

Necrizy added
[list]
[*]Normal Projectile
[*]Tactical is a teleport, upon teleporting it also pushes away enemies and projectiles
[*]Ultimate is a gravity bomb, shoots a projectile that upon impact creates a vortex that pulls projectiles and enemies inside. 
[/list]
	   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38196885/cf6490c53e6f9511679cc20f0572ea12d648e86e.png[/img]

Changed mana system
[list]
[*]starting max mana is now 10 instead of 15
[*]Everytime you collect 5 chests, your max mana increases by 1
[*]The point of this change was to incentivize collecting chests even when the player is at max mana
[/list]

After you die, there is now a retry button and a main menu button instead of being taken directly to the main menu after death.

Made walk animations look faster

New enemy added: Spectre. Can be found in the third area. In short, it revives dead enemies if they're corpses are still on the ground. 

Explosions
[list]
[*]changed explosion sprite
[*]added some sound variations for explosions
[/list]
- Changed minimap
[list]
[*]Each cell is more clearly sectioned off
[*]the end room cell is now white outline with dark middle
[/list]

Minor nerf to speed relic, was 40% speed increase is now 30%

Turrets
[list]
[*]Now have 5 health (4 before) 
[*]Turrets now have a 1.2 second base cooldown for firing (was 2 second before)
[*]They now also have a .2 offset for their cooldown (1.0 second minimum, 1.4 second maximum cooldown)
[/list]
Abominations
[list]
[*]now have 6 health (4 before)
[*]Faster charge up time
[*]Shots now have spread
[/list]

Big turrets now have 7 health (5 before)

Looping!
[list]
[*]After you beat the final boss, you have the option to loop the game
[*]Looping makes all the combat rooms hard, and adds +1 HP for each enemy per loop (and much more health for bosses). 
[*]You keep going with all your perks, relics, and mana. 
[*]You can loop infinitely 
[*]Each loop increases score gained by 50% 
[/list]

When you are in a boss fight, it will always be day. No more sudden changes to night during intense fights or needing to wait until its day to fight the bosses.
